items.title: Pourquoi Kering est en difficulte: Gucci, dette, luxe en mutation
items.summary: French-language analysis argues Kering's crisis is fundamentally about eroded brand desirability, not just balance-sheet stress: Gucci generates roughly 41 percent of group revenue (EUR6bn in 2025) but posted a 22 percent sales collapse in 2025, dragging the operating margin down from 14.5 to 11.1 percent and pushing net debt to EUR8bn. H1 2026 shows debt falling to EUR3.3bn and Gucci's decline narrowing to about 5 percent, but the piece concludes recovery still hinges on whether Gucci can rebuild genuine cultural relevance, not just cut costs.

items.title: Kering official account continues amplifying Q2 2026 turnaround narrative
items.summary: Kering's official X account continues to circulate its Q2 2026 results messaging, highlighting group revenue of roughly EUR3.65bn (up over 2 percent organically) with Gucci sales down about 2 percent, framed by the company as evidence its ReconKering turnaround plan is taking hold. Post-level engagement metrics (likes/reposts/views) were not accessible without authenticated platform access.

items.title: Gucci official Instagram continues Cruise/Core-era campaign cadence
items.summary: Gucci's official Instagram account (51M followers, 320 posts as of early September) continues to post brand-controlled campaign and archival content; treated as brand-owned activation rather than independent public opinion per sentiment-rubric discount, included here for Buzz-channel completeness. Post-level engagement figures not accessible without authenticated access; account-level follower count is the only visible metric.

items.source: Lux Research Japan (Luxury Market Weekly Report)
items.title: Luxury Market Weekly Report Vol.4 - Gucci early stabilization
items.summary: Weekly luxury-sector roundup covering the EU market notes Gucci's Q2 revenue of EUR1.41bn (down 2 percent, beating the -4 percent consensus), crediting the Borsetto and Paparazzo bag launches for returning leather goods to growth; also flags strong secondary-market collector interest, citing a 530 percent surge in the Gucci Padlock bag's average eBay resale price, and suggests a settled creative-director era could add further recovery momentum.

items.title: Kering turns to secondhand market to win back customers
items.summary: Belgian trade outlet reports Kering is in preliminary talks with specialized secondhand retailers about directly selling pre-owned Gucci, Balenciaga and Saint Laurent pieces, weighing options from an in-house platform to a dedicated vintage sub-brand; critical framing notes the explicit motivation is to re-engage customers who were "deterred by substantial price increases" in recent years, an implicit admission that the brand's own pricing strategy pushed shoppers toward resale instead of retail.

items.title: French-language Trustpilot reviews continue to flag e-commerce service failures
items.summary: Recurring one-star French-language reviews for gucci.com: a July 2026 reviewer says Gucci failed to repair a bracelet still under warranty; other recent entries describe lost return parcels with no follow-up from carriers and "despicably slow and unsatisfactory service." Recurring theme is that after-sales support is weak relative to the brand's price point; independent aggregator Custplace shows an overall France rating of 1.9/5.
